name: Nolan's basement

objects.text: The sampler and two monitors. A beat called final_FINAL_v7. Nolan says it's not done.
Through the window: the white work van in the driveway. A man is watching it with a coffee.
The couch. Callum could have slept here. Callum chose the van.
A copy of 2K22 (the GOAT), a stack of records and a framed photo of a van.
A bottle of Goldschlager and a yoga mat. Nolan is a different breed on the headstands.
